tool_description: An API that provides numerous quotes said by famous Formula 1 drivers and personalities.
name: F1 drivers quotes
title: F1 drivers quotes

api_list.name: Author with his photo
api_list.description: Shows the author who have quotes saved in this API  with his photo and ID.
api_list.code:
import requests

url = "https://f1-drivers-quotes.p.rapidapi.com/authors/raikkonen"

headers = {
            "X-RapidAPI-Key": "SIGN-UP-FOR-KEY",
            "X-RapidAPI-Host": "f1-drivers-quotes.p.rapidapi.com"
        }

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print(response.json())

test_endpoint.quote: People might call me a liar for this, but I want a fast teammate, I think for two reasons: it's always going to get more out of yourself, and it's always going to be a more true evaluation of where you stand.
test_endpoint.author: Daniel Ricciardo

test_endpoint.quote: If I win the title, I want to know I was the best guy that year, and to be the best, you've got to go against the best.
test_endpoint.author: Daniel Ricciardo

test_endpoint.quote: I like having as many team-mates as possible. It's great, because the more people you can learn off, the better I think it will make you as a driver.
test_endpoint.author: Daniel Ricciardo

test_endpoint.quote: When I joined Formula One, I knew that what I found is that the cars are so much faster, and it took me a little while to understand where to always put the car.
test_endpoint.author: Daniel Ricciardo

test_endpoint.quote: In racing, things start coming up quicker, and the slipstream is stronger, so even judging in the mirrors how quick the cars are approaching isn't always easy.
test_endpoint.author: Daniel Ricciardo

test_endpoint.quote: I've learned what F1 is like, and it is an extremely competitive sport on and off the track.
test_endpoint.author: Daniel Ricciardo

test_endpoint.quote: We know - relationships in this sport, it's very hard to have a really great relationship.
test_endpoint.author: Daniel Ricciardo

test_endpoint.quote: I like high speed corners, but with the F111, it is taking a little time to build up to that.
test_endpoint.author: Daniel Ricciardo

test_endpoint.quote: For my family, it was quite emotional because it has always been a dream of mine to be in Formula 1. For them, to see it come true was quite a special feeling.
test_endpoint.author: Daniel Ricciardo

test_endpoint.quote: In World Series, everything is a bit slower than F1. But each time I sit in the car, whether it is World Series or F1, once I am in the cockpit, I am mentally prepared for what the car is. I don't have to physically drive it to remember what it is doing.
test_endpoint.author: Daniel Ricciardo

test_endpoint.quote: The only place that matters is first.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: In the end, I think in F1 it is very hard for a girl.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: I always try to get the best result out of it, I'm not there to just sit second or sit third. I'm a winner, and I want to win every single race, and I will always go for it.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: I don't need people shouting at me to tell me what I did wrong.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: I think you can improve on everything; you're never perfect.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: My career is more important than girls.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: The smell of fuel, driving on the limit on the edge of sliding, it just gives you a lot of adrenaline.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: Mistakes happen, and they happen to the best of us.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: You always try to fight for yourself, isn't it? You try to do the best possible job.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: To be honest, I never compare myself with the rookies.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: There is no such thing as a low risk lap in Monaco. It doesn't exist if you want to be fast, because you have to be on the limit.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: You always want to do better than last year.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: I just want to do the best I can every time.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: The thing is, all the time I press my radio button, it is broadcast, and sometimes it sounds a bit arrogant - especially the 'I'm not here to finish fourth' - and that is just what comes up in my mind.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: You always have to believe in yourself, and I had that from karting.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: That's what I enjoy, always driving on the limit of what you can do.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: Of course you learn from certain moments, and you always get more and more experience, so maybe in the future you will do some different things, but in general, the basics always stay the same.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: The world championship is what I am here for.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: If you start doubting yourself like that, thinking, 'Am I good enough?' - maybe there is a reason you're thinking that.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: I've raced at the Hungaroring in Formula 3, and it's a bit of a Mickey Mouse track.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: Many people ask, 'What do you need mentally to succeed in F1?' I say, 'What do you mean mentally?'
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: I've always been good at realising what went wrong and stuff, and I was always being able to look at the positives from it.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: It's just racing. Sometimes you have difficult moments, and then you try to work hard, and you keep working hard, and you overcome the situation. It's as simple as that.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: My dad always told me you have to be as quick as you can straight away out of the box. Some people say, 'Feel your way into it; build it up.' No. My dad would say, 'Straight away, you have to be there.' And I think that helps to warm up your tyres and brakes to be on it a bit more from lap one.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: If you are not allowed to defend, what's racing about, then?
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: I was never Mad Max. I was just Max who was trying to get the best result for the team.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: I tell my engineers that they should not overload me with information.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: It is very unfair, and on social media you have all these keyboard warriors who just type something, and they never say it to my face. That's very weak I find.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: I say what I think, and if somebody attacks me unfairly, I definitely tell them.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: If you are a bit weak in your head, maybe you can train your mind, but it will never be your strong point.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: I am not there to finish fourth at the end of the day. I am there to win as a racer, but on the radio, it sounds I am arrogant and not listening to the team, but it is not like that.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: It is not because others tell me I have to change my driving style that I will change.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: In general, the spotlight has been on me.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: Maybe I can drive until I'm 36 or 37. 40.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: I just want to be myself. You learn from yourself, and that doesn't mean you have to drive slower; it actually means you have to drive faster, but maybe with a little bit in control, and that's what I learned.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: I think it is very important to not be too much on social media. You have a lot of positive comments but also negative ones, and at the end of the day, that shouldn't affect you, but it is much more important not to read it so you just don't know.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: It is not only about just doing a fast lap. You also need to use your brains and be clever, and I think that is what makes you a complete driver at the end.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: I have good people around me, so I always have advice. A lot of people can talk to me, but it's me, of course, who still has to take that to the track and to perform.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: I never even think of the mental side of things because I never had any issues.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: Of course I think everybody has moments in their careers when they're frustrated, or you're not happy with the current situation.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: For me, it doesn't matter if you are fighting a world champion or not.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: Of course my dad went to Formula One, so I think that my dad is the better driver of the two. But I think, for a girl, my mom was not too bad, of course.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: My ultimate dream is just to become world champion, and not only once. So that's my dream, and it doesn't matter with which team it is.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: I have to say it was a very good start, a very good first season. I enjoyed it a lot, scored good points and gained a lot of experience.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: I want to rely on my gut feeling. Isn't that what made great race drivers in the end?
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: At the end of the day, driving on the limit, sometimes over it to achieve the best out of it, especially at such high speeds... mistakes are easily done.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: I think if you show respect on the track to each other, and you do clean overtaking moves, then they get respect for you.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: To just slow yourself down, just to not do anything and drive around - I'm not like that. I'm not here to fill up the field.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: People always think they know better. In football, everybody thinks they can be head coach and do it better. It's the same in F1: they always know better, even if they have no experience of it.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: I want to win because I am the fastest out there instead, not by luck; then it means a lot more to you.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: This is what I have always done in my life, just racing and driving cars and go-karts fast.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: The biggest critic I have in my life is my dad, so everything else is just a breeze; it doesn't really matter to me.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: As a driver, it is important to focus on yourself and believe in yourself, and there shouldn't be a reason why, when you are in F1 and there is more attention, you change your approach.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: Of course there will be difficult times, and there will be more in the future, but I know what I have to do in the car.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: I get really tired of all the comments saying I should change my approach.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: You have to be patient: trust the team, that they can deliver a good job.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: If you haven't really raced a lot in lower categories, and you make the jump to Formula One, you have to learn in Formula One, and a lot more people are watching.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: I just enjoy it and drive as fast I can. But so many people think your psychology is such a massive thing. For me, it's not necessary.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: Of course I am doing a good job, but you can always improve, and I just leave it up to people outside, around me or whatever, to judge on that.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen

test_endpoint.quote: Overtaking is one thing. That is an art. But defending as well. You should be able to defend your position.
test_endpoint.author: Max Verstappen
